links.outcome: Scribe note hallucinations, omissions, and inclusions relative to ground-truth summary
links.effect: Baseline about 0.5 hallucinations and one omission per consultation under ideal audio; omissions were most prevalent error; hallucinations infrequent but occurred with acoustic noise.

links.outcome: Scribe accuracy under simulated primary care conditions with varied microphones and noise
links.effect: Accuracy degraded with microphone distance and background noise; laptop microphone worst; complete information loss at 4.5 m.
links.quote: At 4.5 m from the consultation, for all microphones tested, all facts were omitted.
